highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.151.0 bumps to Skia m151 and ports several hot-path conversions to managed C# for better performance.
highlights_body: Color, premultiply, and HarfBuzz text-shaping paths gain allocation-free, zero-copy implementations, alongside upstream Chrome M151 bug fixes.

bullets.detail: SkiaSharp now tracks Skia m151, including several rounds of upstream chrome/m151 bug fixes merged along the way.

bullets.lead: Fixed a native resource leak decoding images
bullets.detail: SKImage.FromEncodedData(SKData, SKRectI) no longer leaks a native resource on each call.

bullets.lead: Color and premultiply conversions moved to managed code
bullets.detail: SKColor to SKColorF conversion and single-value SKPMColor premultiply/unpremultiply now run in managed integer math instead of round-tripping through native calls, and SKColor hex parsing gained ReadOnlySpan<char> overloads.

Buffer.AddUtf8(string) now uses a pooled allocation-free UTF-8 encode, Tag.Parse and SKFourByteTag.Parse no longer allocate a char[4] per call, and SKShaper glyph results are read via zero-copy spans.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Contributed the Skia submodule WASM build fix and follow-up performance work in this release

preview_summaries.v4.151.0-rc.1.1: Release Candidate 1 finalized the WASM Emscripten 5.0.6 static libraries and remaining m151 sync work.
preview_summaries.v4.151.0-preview.2.1: Preview 2 delivered the managed color/premultiply performance ports and HarfBuzzSharp allocation reductions.
preview_summaries.v4.151.0-preview.1.1: Preview 1 opened the line with the Skia milestone 151 bump and initial upstream bug-fix syncs.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1 reduces UTF-8 buffer and tag-parsing allocations and reads shaper glyph results via zero-copy spans.
